summary.name: Libre Projects
summary.one_liner: Libre Projects is a directory-style site promoting free and open source web services that are hosted, usable, and licensed under free terms.
use_cases: find free and open source web services
discover hosted alternatives to proprietary platforms
suggest an open source project for listing
learn about trust in hosted services
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Libre Projects as a collection of web services that aim for free usage and sharing under licenses such as MIT, GNU AGPL, or Creative Commons. It states that it excludes advertising from corporations offering libre features as a niche service. It discusses the trust model of hosted services and the ideal of running a FreedomBox at home, while noting the Unhosted architecture as an alternative for people who cannot do that. Visitors are invited to contribute code, suggest open source projects that are hosted and usable, and spread the word. Libre Projects contributors have waived copyright on the project; logos carry their own license.
notable: Lists only free-licensed web services (MIT, GNU AGPL, Creative Commons or similar)
Promotes the Unhosted architecture as a trust-minimizing alternative to hosted services
Contributors have waived copyright on the project
caveats: The page text is mostly a manifesto and does not list specific services, so the directory contents are unclear from this page
Page title is 'Ooops!', suggesting a possible error page at capture time
